messages.subject: Setting starting values for null models in gdistsamp
parts:
All:

I have read through some of the previous inquiries into setting starting values for use in unmarked, but I am still having difficulty applying some of the solutions to overcome my analysis issues. I am currently unable to run the null models using the various key functions in gdistsamp without the error (displayed below) coming up. The

Error in optim(starts, nll, method = method, hessian = se, ...) :
  initial value in 'vmmin' is not finite

I have tried fitting various starting values using starts=c(), but to no avail. Any suggestions for selecting starting values for use in the null models?

ccspframe<-unmarkedFrameGDS(ccspform, dist.breaks=c(0,10,20,30,40,50),
                            survey="line", tlength=100, unitsIn="m", numPrimary=3)
summary(ccspframe)

null model
ccspdist<-gdistsamp(~1,~1,~1, ccspframe, keyfun="halfnorm", output="abund")

Best regards,
Craig Marshall

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Setting starting values for null models in gdistsamp
parts:
The solution to the error is that the argument "tlength" should be a vector with length=nSites. Thank you for the help.

ccspframe<-unmarkedFrameGDS(ccspform, dist.breaks=c(0,10,20,30,40,50),
                            survey="line", tlength=rep(100, nrow(ccspform)),
                            unitsIn="m", numPrimary=3)
